description: Header file defining the RilSapSocket class, which manages socket communication for Bluetooth SAP module within the RIL (Radio Interface Layer) in Android. It includes class declarations, method prototypes, and data structures for socket handling, request processing, and response management.

classes.name: RilSapSocket
classes.description: Represents a socket for communication between Bluetooth SAP module and the RIL daemon, handling request dispatching, unsolicited responses, and socket management.

methods.name: initSapSocket
methods.description: Initializes a new SAP socket with the given name and radio functions, adding it to the socket list.

methods.name: printList
methods.description: Prints the current list of active SAP sockets.

methods.name: getSocketById
methods.description: Retrieves a RilSapSocket instance based on the socket ID.

methods.name: addSocketToList
methods.description: Adds a new socket to the socket list if it does not already exist.

methods.name: dispatchRequest
methods.description: Dispatches a request message to the lower layers for processing.

methods.name: onRequestComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a request, processing the response or error.

methods.name: onUnsolicitedResponse
methods.description: Handles unsolicited responses received on the socket.
